item.title: Black marketing of commercial LPG cylinders suspected in several districts of Andhra Pradesh
item.description: Hotel owners say that LPG distributors have offered to arrange cylinders through alternative channels at higher prices.

item.title: Gas Rationing: How Govt plans to ensure gas supplies amid West Asia crisis
item.description: Amid West Asia tensions, India faces a natural gas supply crunch, leading to nationwide rationing. The government’s new Natural Gas (Supply Regulation) Order prioritizes essential services like domestic PNG/CNG, while industrial sectors face significant supply cuts.

item.title: BCCI to gift Rs 131 crore to T20 World Cup-winning Indian team
item.description: The amount will be distributed among the team contingent tht includes 15 players, coaching staff and other support staff.

item.title: Box office: The Kerala Story 2 falls behind as Thaai Kizhavi rises | Full report INSIDE
item.description: The box office battle between The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond and Thaai Kizhavi is getting interesting. While the controversial sequel struggles to match its predecessor’s pace, the Tamil rural drama is steadily gaining ground. Here’s a detailed look at the latest collection numbers.

item.title: SC directs Govt to frame compensation policy for Covid vaccine-related side effects, deaths
item.description: The matter also traces back to a 2022 order by the Kerala High Court, which had asked the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) to frame guidelines for identifying deaths caused by COVID-19 vaccine complications and for compensating the dependents of such victims.

item.title: Meet Paperclip AI: New Open-Source Tool that helps you build a full company with zero humans
item.description: Paperclip is shaking up AI by letting users run full companies with AI agents only. Set goals like building a top app, hire virtual teams, and monitor from anywhere. With GitHub buzz, it’s a fresh way for solopreneurs to skip hiring woes, but real success stories are yet to emerge.

item.title: Think adventure is only for young? These outdoor sports prove for seniors otherwise
item.description: Discover the best outdoor adventure sports for seniors that improve fitness, boost mental health, and add excitement to life after 60. From trekking and cycling to kayaking and birdwatching, explore safe and fun activities perfect for older adults.

item.title: Airtel’s Nxtra eyes $1B funding as Alpha wave global joins AI data centre expansion
item.description: Airtel’s data centre arm Nxtra plans to raise $1 billion to expand its AI-ready data centre infrastructure in India. Alpha Wave Global is expected to invest about $400 million, while Airtel and Carlyle may contribute $300 million each to scale capacity to gigawatt levels.

item.title: Audi have opened bookings for SQ8; SUV slotted above standard Q8
item.description: Audi have opened the bookings for the SQ8, which is set to be launched on March 17th. The SQ8 will sit below the RSQ8, though will share the 4-litre twin-turbo V8 engine, which for this model has been tuned down to making 507 bhp and 770 Nm of torque.

item.title: Gujarat Titans appoint Hayden as batting coach for IPL 2026
item.description: Hayden will replace fellow Australian Matthew Wade, who was one of the assistant coaches in 2025 edition. This year’s IPL begins on March 28.
